descriptions.zh: 该接口为异步接口，实例的重启不是立即完成的，成功调用后，实例会先进入重启中（restarting）状态，当返回的状态为运行中（running）时代表重启成功。
descriptions.en: This operation is asynchronous. After you call this operation, the instance enters a restarting state but does not restart immediately. The restart is complete when the instance status changes to running.
